name: What factors determine the cost of kitchen door frame repair?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of kitchen door frame repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen door frame repair costs depend on the extent of the damage, the frame material, and whether the door itself needs rehanging. Minor adjustments—such as securing stripped hinge screw holes, adjusting strike plates, or patching cosmetic scratches—fall at the lower end of the spectrum. Splicing rotted wood sections, rebuilding split strike jambs from forced entry, or custom-milling trim to match older kitchen cabinetry increases labor time and material expense. Replacing the entire pre-hung jamb unit also costs more than spot repairs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on the damage severity, whether wood has rotted, if custom trim matching is needed, and whether the frame requires minor patching or full jamb rebuilding.
